statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-45799 (GHSA-7xpr-hc2w-34m9, CWE-129) is an unchecked array index in com.squareup.wire.ProtoReader.skipGroup(): when skipping an unknown START_GROUP field the sub-field length is read as a signed varint without rejecting negative values, so a crafted protobuf payload underflows the position counter and throws an unchecked ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException (availability-only DoS). It is reachable only when an application decodes adversary-controlled protobuf wire-format bytes through Wire's runtime decoder (ProtoReader / ProtoAdapter.decode). Reachability in this image: gradle dependencyInsight on the runtimeClasspath shows wire-runtime-jvm is pulled into a single plugin, data-prepper-plugins:kafka-plugins, transitively via software.amazon.glue:schema-registry-serde:1.1.24 -> com.squareup.wire:wire-compiler:5.2.0 -> wire-kotlin-generator / wire-java-generator -> wire-runtime. It is the Wire schema-to-code generator (a build/codegen tool) leaked onto the runtime classpath by the Glue serde, not a runtime protobuf decoder. The Glue Schema Registry serde that data-prepper's kafka plugin uses handles Avro/JSON schemas; no data-prepper code imports com.squareup.wire (verified by scanning the source tree) and no pipeline decodes untrusted protobuf through Wire's ProtoReader. The vulnerable skipGroup path is not on any code path the image exercises. No upstream fix is published for 5.2.0 at scan time.

wire-runtime-jvm 5.2.0 is a transitive dependency from upstream DataHub 1.5.0.6. The vulnerability affects versions <=5.3.3 with no fix available upstream. Investigating upgrade path that does not break DataHub compatibility.
